title: Winter Break Homework
synopsis: Did your school give you homework to do during winter break? Chinese students dislike their homework, but what if it was turned into a game?

fullText.simplified:
你的寒假作业是什么？

    现在，中国学生正在放寒假，不用去学校上课。你不要以为不用上课就可以去玩了，寒假作业你做完了吗？中国的小学生、初中生和高中生放寒假都要做寒假作业，所以他们都讨厌寒假作业。但是最近，有个寒假作业受到了很多高中生的欢迎。
    这个寒假作业叫“化学加油站”，它是一个网上游戏，游戏的内容就是高中化学里的知识点。要想游戏玩得好，就要化学学得好。做这个游戏的老师说：“因为化学要背的东西很多，很无聊。把要背的东西变成游戏后，可以一边玩游戏一边背，学生就不会觉得无聊了。”
    寒假作业变成了玩游戏，学生不但不用写寒假作业了，而且还学到了很多知识。
fullText.traditional:
你的寒假作業是什麼？

    現在，中國學生正在放寒假，不用去學校上課。你不要以為不用上課就可以去玩了，寒假作業你做完了嗎？中國的小學生、初中生和高中生放寒假都要做寒假作業，所以他們都討厭寒假作業。但是最近，有個寒假作業受到了很多高中生的歡迎。
    這個寒假作業叫“化學加油站”，它是一個網上遊戲，遊戲的內容就是高中化學裡的知識點。要想遊戲玩得好，就要化學學得好。做這個遊戲的老師說：“因為化學要背的東西很多，很無聊。把要背的東西變成遊戲後，可以一邊玩遊戲一邊背，學生就不會覺得無聊了。”
    寒假作業變成了玩遊戲，學生不但不用寫寒假作業了，而且還學到了很多知識。

raw.synopsis: Did your school give you homework to do during winter break? Chinese students dislike their homework, but what if it was turned into a game?
sentence_translations: What is your winter break homework?
Right now Chinese students have winter break and do not have to go to school and attend class.
But don't you think that no classes means you can just go play; have you finished your winter break homework?
Chinese primary, junior high and senior high school students all have to do winter break homework during the winter holidays.
And therefore they all dislike winter break homework.
But recently, there is a winter break homework which has been well received by a lot of senior high school students.
This winter break homework is called “Chemistry Gas Station” and is an online game.
The game contains knowledge points from senior high school chemistry.
If you want to play the game well, you have to learn your chemistry well.
The teacher who created this game says: “Because you must learn a lot of things by heart in chemistry, it can be boring.”
By turning the things you have to memorize into a game, you can play while memorizing, and the students will not think it is boring.
The winter break homework turned into playing a game.
Not only do the students not have to write homework, they are also obtaining a lot of knowledge.
